torsos:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: FOUR STATIC PAINTED PAPER-PUPPET TORSO PARTS, not animation frames. Reference is our selected game character's upright full body. Preserve the exact leather-shadow-puppet boy's face, black red-tied high ponytail, short red scarf, cream tunic, dark cuffs, brown belt and round buckle. Same outlined textured cut-leather art.
Make a transparent square image in invisible 2x2 layout, each part fully isolated within its quarter with 40px clear margins. Top-left RIGHT profile; top-right FRONT; bottom-left LEFT profile; bottom-right BACK. Only ONE continuous head-neck-torso per quarter, with complete ponytail, shoulders, shirt, belt and full hip-covering tunic hem. NO arms or hands extending beyond shoulders; NO trousers, legs, bow or accessories. Fill cloth naturally behind future arm attachments. Keep shoulder sleeve sockets small, rounded, suitable for overlaying separate sleeves. In FRONT/BACK, shirt shoulders are level.
Critical anatomy: relaxed straight spine, neutral pelvis, vertical chest-over-belt axis; in profiles, ear, shoulder socket and hip are vertically stacked, no forward head, no lean, no thrusting belly. Belt's actual side center lies vertically under shoulder socket; do not center on ponytail silhouette. Head size, torso length, waist width match reference, 3.5-head compact child. Four parts same anatomical scale, not four resized bounding boxes. Tunic continuous across waist with overlapping hip hem; no exposed body joint.
True transparent alpha outside parts, including gaps in hair; opaque paint. No paper backdrop, haze, shadows, grids, labels, numbers or text. These are static source parts for a leather puppet animation with anatomically marked joints.
limbs:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: four STATIC individual painted puppet limb segments, not animation frames. Use the supplied boy identity only to copy his exact cream sleeve, dark wrist cuff, skin tone and textured leather/ink finish.
Transparent square image in invisible 2x2 layout, at least40px margin around each complete isolated part, all horizontally from left to right.
TOP LEFT: ONE upper-arm segment, from rounded shoulder socket at LEFT to rounded elbow at RIGHT, cream loose elbow-length sleeve, complete silhouette and filled cloth. NO forearm or hand. Broad near shoulder, narrower elbow, relaxed straight segment.
TOP RIGHT: ONE forearm and LEFT bow-grip hand, elbow at LEFT, wrist to RIGHT; matching dark cuff, small hand with closed relaxed curled fingers forming a grip at RIGHT. The grip center is at center of hand, fingers clearly wrapped but NO bow or object. Forearm straight. Neutral side/front view, no extra thumb.
BOTTOM LEFT: ONE forearm and RIGHT string-hook hand, elbow at LEFT, wrist and hand toward RIGHT, matching dark cuff; hand three fingers gently hooked together, for a sporting archery string anchor near cheek. NO string, weapon or arrow. Straight forearm, correct fingers and thumb.
BOTTOM RIGHT: ONE forearm with relaxed small hand, same costume, elbow LEFT and fingers toward RIGHT. Hand loose with gently bent fingers for walking at side.
No full character, no torso, no legs, no bow, no scenery or decoration. These are static skin/cloth parts for an offline painted animation. True transparency, opaque skin and cloth; no backdrop, halo, labels, text or grids. Do not bend the upperarm and forearm together into one part.
